Licensed Home Services Contractor Georgia

You are looking for a home-services contractor in Georgia. Build Heritage is a licensed and insured contractor serving metro Atlanta and Georgia.

About Build Heritage

Build Heritage offers 8 trades: Packing & Moving, Painting, Drywall, Flooring & Vinyl, Framing, Doors, Window & Door Trim, and Roofing & Tiles.

Getting a Quote for Your Project

To get started, you can fill out the quote form or contact Build Heritage at info@buildheritage.org. You'll receive a written and itemized quote within one business day.

What You Get and What It Costs

The cost guide, updated in August 2026, provides ranges for various services to help you plan your project. For example, a whole-home interior repaint can cost between $3,000-$8,000, while a full roof replacement can range from $9,000-$20,000. It's recommended to hold back 10-15% on top of a quote for potential hidden issues.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? Build Heritage serves metro Atlanta and Georgia, including cities like Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, and Columbus.
